tagline: Spices, herbs and pantry essentials from South Tangerang.

story.title: A broad spice shelf, not a one-product story.
story.body: AurelShop2018 operates a wide marketplace catalog from South Tangerang spanning dried spices, powdered botanicals, herbal drink ingredients, fresh ingredients and pantry staples. The NFC page therefore focuses on product discovery and direct ordering instead of unsupported claims about customer counts or shelf life.
